    y = n % 10
    return x + 3 * y

def find_cycles(limit):
    cycles = []
    visited_global = set()
    for i in range(limit):
        path = []

        path_set = set()

            path_set.add(curr)
            path.append(curr)
            curr = f(curr)

            cycle_start_idx = path.index(curr)
            cycle = path[cycle_start_idx:]
            cycles.append(cycle)

            visited_global.add(p)
    return cycles
